result.locked_model: Sum of Voigt profiles (Lorentzian-dominant; collapse to pure Lorentzian if Gaussian width refines to ~0) on a constant/linear baseline. Component count set per spectrum: 2 Voigt lines in the low-T slow-exchange regime, 1 Voigt line in the high-T fast-exchange regime; intermediate spectra fit with whichever count the data justify.
